Name: Renny's Raccoon Children
Author: renjaminnifer
Description:
Are you sick of human children? Do you find them loud and annoying? Wanna replace them with cute lil raccoons? Well, have I got the thing for you!

Introducing [size=4][i][b]Renny's Raccoon Children !

[/b][/i][/size]That's right folks, no longer do you have to deal with your annoying human kids! Now you can just have a bunch of cute lil raccoons all over your house!
(Screenshots from discord user squishface, they're also using other mods that aren't included in this one)

[b][u]Instructions:[/u][/b]

1. Download the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 
2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
3. Download Renny's Raccoon Children and open it with something like Win.rar
4. Decide what color raccoon you want and extract the corresponding folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
5. Enjoy!

[b][u]Updates:[/u][/b]
1.1 - Now lets you just choose whatever raccoon color you want
